about: What Plaid's test bank (sandbox) really sent on Oct 9, 2026, for a test user with made-up accounts shaped like his, saved as it came (API version 2020-09-14): the history, with the label Plaid gives each item (personal_finance_category). Made by live/labels.live.ts, to check what the labels really are before Setup day suggests bank rules from them: transfers both ways, card payments, payments to people, card fees and interest, a bank fee on checking. The keys that open the connection were never saved. The ids are the test bank's own; every name and number is made up.
